name: Azure DevOps
description: Unofficial. Azure DevOps in Orca: a board you can work in, one-click agents, and work items, pull requests, pipelines and wikis.

cover.alt: The plugin's logo and name beside its full-tab board, with a card's details open: tasks, a pull request with its check, and Start a workspace and agent.

screenshots.alt: The full-tab board with a card's panel open: its description, tasks with a progress bar, a pull request and its check, a comment and the start footer.
screenshots.caption: A board you can work in: open a card to comment, reassign, tick off tasks or start an agent.

screenshots.alt: The Work tab by board column with tasks inside their story, and an item's details with Clone from Azure DevOps chosen and Start a workspace and agent.
screenshots.caption: Start a workspace and agent from any item, in a repository in Orca or one it clones.

screenshots.alt: The PRs tab: release sets grouped by project with their checks and actions, and the To review list grouped the same way.
screenshots.caption: Pull requests grouped by project, ready to share, approve or review.

screenshots.alt: The Pipelines tab: runs grouped by project with stage chips, and a production approval with Approve, Reject and Share.
screenshots.caption: Every run with its stages, and approvals you can give or share.

screenshots.alt: The Wiki tab: the page tree with folders and drafts, and a page with diagram and table cards and Open in tab.
screenshots.caption: Browse and edit wikis; Open in tab draws Mermaid diagrams full width.

settings.description: Repositories cloned from Azure DevOps go here, each in a folder named after the repository.

settings.title: Pull request share line
settings.description: One line per pull request. [text]({url}) is the link. Also {repo}, {project}, {source}, {target}, {author}.

settings.title: Notify when my pipeline runs fail
Notify when a run waits for approval
settings.description: Your runs, and approvals you can give.

Notify when someone asks for my review

Approval share line
settings.description: One line per approval. [text]({url}) is the link. Also {stage}, {requestedBy}, {project}.

settings.title: Microsoft sign-in: app (client) ID
settings.description: From the app registration your admin created. See the README's admin guide.

settings.title: Microsoft sign-in: tenant
settings.description: Used only when an organization's tenant can't be found. A tenant ID or domain; leave empty for any work or school account.

settings.title: HTTPS proxy
settings.description: Send the plugin's Azure DevOps and Microsoft traffic through this proxy, like http://proxy.example.com:8080. Proxies that need a password aren't supported.

settings.title: Extra CA certificates file
settings.description: The full path to a PEM file of certificates to trust, for networks that inspect TLS.

settings.title: Trust the system's certificates
settings.description: Also trust the certificates your operating system trusts.
